svg.title: Pairing Lab. Forty held-out software issues.
svg.desc: Each angular position is one observed issue. Inner marks show the primary stack, outer marks the added stack. Filled marks indicate a passing patch. Gold diamonds identify the two additional issues resolved by the added stack. The data are historical independent grades.
svg.text: We selected on 60 issues, then tested on 40 held out.
A second stack raised coverage from 16 issues to 18.
Each route could use 80M tokens across all 40 issues.
Data: Zhao, Poskitt & Lo · Pairing Matters · Figshare v1 · CC BY 4.0
October 2026 archive · Retrospective union of independently graded patches. Both attempts contribute their reported token volume.
